thread:
maria: Heads up — 3 nodes in eu-gpu-pool-1 flagged thermal shutdowns overnight. 4 x H100s with repeated thermal trips. Cluster degraded ~27% capacity. DC alerted. @ops-bot created incident INC-4532.
ops-bot: incident INC-4532 created by maria. Priority: high. Affected service: inference-prod-eu. Docs: <https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-4532>
nora: saw error spikes at 03:12 UTC, failover kicked in to us-west. Latency +30ms on p50, some timeouts for small batch jobs. Rolling jobs now on fallback, but sustained load will eat credits.
maria: need temporary replacements or expedited RMA. kev can you confirm vendor lead time and if we can get air expedite? tagging nexasupply.
kev: pinged nexasupply. Current stock: EU pool zero H100s in local inventory. They have 8 units available in FRA warehouse but need RMA auth + customs doc. Standard ship ETA 6-8 business days, air expedite 2-3 days at +35% freight. PO amend needed.
nexasupply: (NexaSupply Rep) Hey team — we can prioritize 4 units for Redwood, expedite available. We'll need RMA return authorization for the DOA units, serials, and a proforma invoice. Also HS code confirmation for customs.
maria: serials: HW-2045-A, HW-2045-B, HW-2045-C, HW-2045-D (these are the failing units). Want to request partial exchange + temporary loaners if possible. Can you hold 4 units in FRA hub?
nexasupply: Holding 4 units pending PO amendment and cover note. Proforma attached: AWB will be 1Z999FRA0001 (example). Customs HS: 8471.50. We'll waive expedited surcharge if Redwood covers 50% of freight.
finance: 50% freight share ok as short-term. Need updated invoice and new line item code RU-EXP-01.
maria: ops detail — can we accept crossdock arrival at FRA and local courier to our AMS DC? Lead time then ~48 hours within EU once cleared.
lee: ops-supply — yes, FRA crossdock to AMS via local courier possible. Need pickup window and manifest. I can schedule once nexasupply confirms AWB & ETA.
kev: I'll raise PO amendment today EOD to cover 50% freight and loaner clause. @finance please approve the payment terms T+7.
finance: approved T+7.
nora: question: can we hot-swap KV cache reclaim to reduce pressure instead of immediate replacement? Maria?
maria: doing cache reclaim now, but degraded models still hitting thermal thresholds during long seq generation. We need hardware swap too.
kev: nexasupply requested RMA return label for the failing serials. Can we do depot swap or do we need to ship back to vendor? Depot swap preferred to avoid customs.
lee: depot swap possible if depot accepts 'refurb swap' flow. Need return authorizations and packing slips.
nexasupply: We can accept depot returns in NL. Please ensure returns use RMA-RED-4532 on the shipment. Once depot receives units & verifies DOA, we'll dispatch replacements from FRA same day.
maria: ok creating RMA-RED-4532 now. RMA notes: thermal tears, repeated shutdowns. attaching logs.
maria: logs:
````
[2026-02-21T03:10:22Z] thermal_trip: GPU0 temp spike -> 116C, throttle -> shutdown
[2026-02-21T03:10:24Z] error: nvml: gpu reset failure
[2026-02-21T03:12:10Z] node_marked_unhealthy: eu-node-42
````
kev: thanks. @nexasupply please confirm: once depot confirms, replacements shipped FRA->AMS via courier, ETA 24-48h intra-EU. Confirm and send AWB final.
nexasupply: Confirmed. Courier ETA from FRA to AMS 24h once cleared. We'll send final AWB + proforma by 11:00 CET. We'll include loaner clause and credit memo for freight 50%.
lee: scheduling pickup window tomorrow 09:00-12:00 CET at eu-datacenter-AMS.
nora: I'll monitor latency and scale down non-critical batches. Ping here once AWB arrives.
maria: assigned tasks:
- kev: PO amendment & payment (due EOD)
- lee: depot pickup scheduling
- nora: traffic & cache mitigations
- kev to confirm AWB and update ticket INC-4532

kev: on it.

kev: PO amended and sent, invoice RU-EXP-01 attached. Payment terms T+7 confirmed.
nexasupply: Received PO, sending AWB 1Z999FRA0001-REV1 ETA 2026-02-25T08:00Z. Loaner clause added. RMA label RMA-RED-4532 attached.
ops-bot: AWB uploaded to INC-4532. Status: inbound FRA -> AMS. ETA 2026-02-25T08:00Z.
maria: great. once replacements arrive, schedule rolling swap during low-traffic window 02:00-04:00 UTC. @nora coordinate.
nora: noted. will schedule canary and ramp.
maria: thanks everyone. closing thread once replacements accepted at depot.
